name: smoothing_roi_pilot_v1
mask: ROI-relative feathered ellipse; broad eye/mouth exclusions; geometric approximation, not segmentation; undetected ROI left unchanged
filter_order: RGB -> frozen native ROI -> masked bilateral blend -> existing bicubic299 -> normalization; lossless PNG, no extra JPEG
training_target: random one of three strengths per paired train view; identical probability for real/fake; DANN masks target class labels
validation: original validation ROC-AUC only; fixed 3 epochs
evaluation: same test subset, normal + all three strengths; AUC/FPR/FNR at threshold0.5
generalization_claim: Synthetic smoothing pilot, NOT official Instagram or unseen-strength generalization
